name: ROLLING THIN FILM OVEN
desc: Automatic Rolling Thin Film Oven (RTFOT) engineered to simulate the short-term aging (STA) of bituminous binders under continuous rotation in strict compliance with AASHTO T240 standards. Features an 8-bottle testing capacity layout operating at a precision-controlled rotation speed of 20 RPM.
features: Full operational compliance with international AASHTO T240 protocols
8 Bottles carousel carrier containment wheel setup
High-stability fixed performance tracking at exactly 20 RPM velocity
Specialized integrated Vertical Down Airflow circulation system
Constant hot-zone thermal tracking baseline managed up to 180°C
